title: use of undeclared identifier '_BitScanForward'
body:
glm-0.9.7.2 (stable)
llvm/clang 3.7.1 on Windows 10

```
#define GLM_MESSAGES
#include <glm/glm.hpp>


int main()
{
    return 0;
}
```
